Op. 1043A02 LPG SYSTEM LINES PIPE DRAINING OPERATIONS

1. Disconnect the connector (1a) for the supply pipe to the supply solenoid valve (1b).

3. Remove the rigid supply pipe (3a) from the supply solenoid valve to the pressure sensor/connector; if this operation proves difficult, loosen the nuts (3b) fixing the intermediate block.
